programme.desc: 前途無量改編自小説錢途，由白宇王志飛董勇李乃文王宥鈞主演，是一部以現代職場為題材的電視劇該劇由多位實力派老劇骨出演，以生活化的劇情背景講述職場逆襲，內容精彩絕倫！故事講述林強（白宇飾）是聯眾銀行總行授信審批部的副總經理，他不願意為問題貸款簽字，因此得罪了上級領導，被貶到業績表現最差的龍源支行，與林強同期進入銀行的摯友鄭帥（王宥鈞 飾）也受到牽連，一起被降職龍源支行管理混亂不堪，林強以出眾的專業能力，迅速發現了龍源的問題所在，很快建立起了一支工作團隊，並協助支行的員工們爭取應有的利益林強的行動激怒行長郝偉（李洪濤飾），開始對他施加種種壓力林強陷入事業危機，別無選擇下進行反擊，他查明了貸款案的問題，並成功解決最終，林強不僅實現了職業理想，也為銀行行業重新確立了秩序和規則，維護銀行人的初衷，展現出一個逆襲的職場故事

programme.title: A.I.
programme.desc: A.I.는 거장 스탠리 큐브릭 감독이 평생의 숙원으로 삼았던 영화였다. 본래 진짜 로봇을 주인공으로 삼으려던 큐브릭의 목표는 실현되기 어려웠고, 큐브릭은 시나리오와 콘티를 거의 완성해 둔 채로 세상을 떠나고 말았다. 큐브릭의 뜻을 이어받은 것은 스티븐 스필버그 감독이었고, 그는 큐브릭에 대한 경의로 그가 완성해 놓은 부분만큼은 그의 본래 구상과 거의 똑같은 모습으로 만든 뒤 미완으로 남았던 부분에 살을 붙였다. 브라이언 올디스의 단편 소설 Supertoys last all summer lomg에서 착안한 이야기라고 한다. 두 거장의 스타일이 어우러지고 또 충돌하기도 하는 데서 두 사람의 연출 스타일을 비교해 보는 재미가 있고, 식스 센스에서 놀라운 연기로 아카데미 남우조연상 후보에 오르기도 했던 할리 조엘 오스먼트의 연기는 이 영화에서도 뛰어나다. 다양한 미래 세계와 편리한 미래 생활들이 등장하긴 하지만 차가운 배경에서 로봇들과 함께 사는 인간들의 건조한 미래 모습이 드러나기도 한다.

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 善德女王
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宮中權力的美室，一心想成為王后，雖然摩耶王后在她的詭計下死裡逃生，還身懷六甲回到宮中，但摩耶王后懷的雙胞胎卻成就不幸的宿命，因為王室流傳一個預言御出雙生，聖骨男盡，意指王室若生出雙胞胎，將使王室男性斷了精氣真平王深知要是王后生下雙胞胎的事實曝光，一家人將會有無止盡的災難，於是命宮女昭火偷偷將其中一個女兒帶出王宮多年後被拋棄的公主德曼回到新羅，與雙胞胎姐姐天明公主同心協力對抗美室美室企圖用各種手段羅織罪名於德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主於一場追捕德曼的陰謀計畫下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新羅的德曼公主因為天明公主的死開始藉著聰慧的頭腦與身旁各方勢力的協助，最終擊垮政敵美室，成為第一個登上新羅王位的女性

programme.title: 包青天
programme.desc: 宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱包青天，為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調人在做天在看舉頭三尺有神明不畏強權，除惡務盡

programme.title: 紫釵奇緣
programme.desc: 紫釵一錯誤終身，才子佳人各天涯，情深難敵功名路，回首已成舊夢痕根據明代戲曲家湯顯祖的經典名著紫釵記改編而成，講述了大唐年間，歌舞名妓霍小玉風流俠客納蘭東書香才子李益和巾幗紅顏盧靖瀾為首的風騷人物，彼此錯綜複雜的命運與感情糾葛一場指腹為婚的誤會，造成浪漫卻無果的錯點鴛鴦，他們在階級差異與強權壓迫中勇於追求真愛，在宮廷權謀與世俗現實的拉扯中身不由己地被推向命運的叉路，自此展開一段關於愛背叛與救贖的傳奇故事

programme.title: 大漢盛世
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 錦衣之下
programme.desc: 天賦異稟的六扇門女捕快袁今夏因為一樁案件和性情狠辣的錦衣衛陸繹結下樑子，今夏本以為此生與他再無交集，奈何冤家路窄朝廷十萬兩修河款不翼而飛，今夏奉命協助陸繹一起下揚州查案，替朝廷找回丟失的官銀本是道不同不相為謀，卻因驚天密案聯手兩人從勢同水火到刮目相看再到情難自已，命運的齒輪從此旋轉在一起然而事與願違，今夏竟是當年夏然案的遺孤，背負家族血仇的她與陸繹之間橫生了無法跨越的鴻溝最後，兩個有情人歷經苦難，為救百姓抗倭寇除奸佞，放下家族仇怨，聯手對敵，衝破世俗枷鎖，勇敢地走到了一起

programme.title: 大漢盛世首
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 紫釵奇緣新
programme.desc: 紫釵一錯誤終身，才子佳人各天涯，情深難敵功名路，回首已成舊夢痕根據明代戲曲家湯顯祖的經典名著紫釵記改編而成，講述了大唐年間，歌舞名妓霍小玉風流俠客納蘭東書香才子李益和巾幗紅顏盧靖瀾為首的風騷人物，彼此錯綜複雜的命運與感情糾葛一場指腹為婚的誤會，造成浪漫卻無果的錯點鴛鴦，他們在階級差異與強權壓迫中勇於追求真愛，在宮廷權謀與世俗現實的拉扯中身不由己地被推向命運的叉路，自此展開一段關於愛背叛與救贖的傳奇故事

programme.title: 包青天
programme.desc: 宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱包青天，為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調人在做天在看舉頭三尺有神明不畏強權，除惡務盡

programme.title: 善德女王
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宮中權力的美室，一心想成為王后，雖然摩耶王后在她的詭計下死裡逃生，還身懷六甲回到宮中，但摩耶王后懷的雙胞胎卻成就不幸的宿命，因為王室流傳一個預言御出雙生，聖骨男盡，意指王室若生出雙胞胎，將使王室男性斷了精氣真平王深知要是王后生下雙胞胎的事實曝光，一家人將會有無止盡的災難，於是命宮女昭火偷偷將其中一個女兒帶出王宮多年後被拋棄的公主德曼回到新羅，與雙胞胎姐姐天明公主同心協力對抗美室美室企圖用各種手段羅織罪名於德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主於一場追捕德曼的陰謀計畫下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新羅的德曼公主因為天明公主的死開始藉著聰慧的頭腦與身旁各方勢力的協助，最終擊垮政敵美室，成為第一個登上新羅王位的女性

programme.title: 夜半歌聲
programme.desc: 1926年的北京，青年演員宋丹平（張國榮飾）因主演歌劇迷倒成千上萬女性，卻與清純富家女杜雲嫣（吳倩蓮飾）墜入愛河然因戲子身份遭杜父反對，杜雲嫣被禁閉在家，許配給某豪門顯貴訂婚夜宴上，杜雲嫣佯病離席私會宋丹平，未婚夫發現後妒火中燒，派人毒打宋丹平並放火焚燒劇院杜雲嫣自此成為外人眼中的瘋婦，而已成廢墟的劇院每逢月圓之夜總傳來虛無縹緲的歌聲

programme.title: 執法先鋒
programme.desc: 檢察官夏令正為主持正義懲惡揚善，不惜鋌而走險，以法外手段殺死嫌疑人

programme.title: 暗戰
programme.desc: 劉德華在片中飾演罹患癌症只剩下4星期生命的華，劉青雲則是飾演警察談判組談判專家何尚生，兩人展開了一場72小時鬥智鬥膽的遊戲杜琪峯以其最擅長的警匪片手法執導劉德華憑藉這部電影拿下個人第一座香港電影金像獎最佳男主角獎

programme.title: 畫皮：情滅
programme.desc: 東海龍女阿若詐死留在凡間，和前世因救她而遁入凡世的王生成婚然而狐妖覬覦阿若體內可讓妖成人的叱玄靈葉，用計害死王生，使阿若情急之下用靈葉替王生續命少了靈葉的阿若無法抑制體內被封印的妖帝，命在旦夕，王生更被狐妖迷惑，心碎的阿若一面抵抗妖帝，一面與狐妖對峙，掙扎著保護變心了的王生

programme.title: 妖貓傳
programme.desc: 故事發生在盛唐時期的長安城，白樂天本是朝廷要官，卻為了收集寫詩的素材而甘願被貶為起居郎長安城內連連發生離奇的死亡事件，就連當今聖上也難逃厄運離奇身亡，這一切都和一隻神出鬼沒的妖貓有關日本僧人空海本為了替皇帝解咒遠渡重洋而來，卻和白樂天意氣相投，兩人決心攜手調查案件真相

programme.title: 偉大的隱藏者
programme.desc: 北韓南派組織的3名間諜，爲了完成任務分別僞裝成智障搖滾青年和高中生潛伏於南韓鄉下，發生一連串既搞笑又驚險刺激的諜戰故事長時間在南韓的生活，以及受到善良熱心鄰居的影響，讓他們逐漸對自己的信念產生質疑

programme.title: 非誠勿擾2
programme.desc: 秦奮決心與笑笑白頭到老，笑笑對秦奮的感情卻止於好感，在秦奮好友的離婚典禮啟發下，兩人決定先從試婚開始然而秦奮深沉的愛意卻對笑笑帶來無形的壓力，兩人只能分道揚鑣距離遠了，感情好像也就淡了，在兩人似乎已忘記對方的同時，他們生活的軌跡又再次交錯，在好友點化下，笑笑似乎明白了婚姻的真諦

programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道人擅長茅山道術，和徒弟阿豪與一隻小殭屍住在一個小鎮上鄰鎮瘟疫蔓延，不時有殭屍出沒，一眉道人帶徒弟與小殭屍前去抓鬼，發現鄰鎮的飲用水源都被屍毒污染，在教堂地下室發現了殭屍的痕跡原來此處一具西洋殭屍意外復活，一場中國法術對付西洋殭屍的精彩好戲於焉上演

programme.title: 雞排英雄
programme.desc: 匯集台灣各路美食小吃的八八八夜市，每日都洋溢著喜悅的氣氛，夜市自治會會長阿華負責調解夜市糾紛以維護攤販利益一晚，女記者林亦南在夜市附近出車禍，生活自此陷入一連串混亂，工作不順加上失戀，還因毀壞電路被罰在八八八進行社區服務，幸得阿華與眾攤販化解亦南身在異鄉的孤獨然議員張進亮被地產商收買，欲強徵八八八土地，阿華帶領攤販向政商宣戰，而張進亮與阿華之間的往事也逐漸浮出水面

programme.title: 鍾馗誅妖傳
programme.desc: 唐朝時期妖怪肆虐，天神因而封印妖王沐風的妖力，使其無法作亂而其伴侶千年花妖風四娘為了解除封印，到處尋找捉妖天師鍾馗的下落面對強妖來襲，鍾馗為了保護百姓，想出一記險招來對付風四娘

programme.title: 神偷大劫案
programme.desc: 轟動全球價值高達300億的鑽石太陽之淚驚傳在澳門現蹤，混跡賭場的盜賊澳門朴從韓國找來多年前被他拋下的一眾夥伴以及香港的一幫大盜齊聚澳門，身懷絕技的眾人看似為了奪取鑽石團結一線，背地裡卻暗潮洶湧伺機而動一顆鑽石一幫老千，一場用盡各種招數偷拐搶騙的驚險暗戰蓄勢待發

programme.title: 國際市場：半世紀的諾言
programme.desc: 故事從1950年韓戰625事件開始，歷經1963年西德在韓國招聘大量礦工和護士的赴德運動1974年的越南戰爭及1983年KBS播出的尋找離散家屬節目，觀眾隨著主角尹德洙成長的腳步，見證了南韓20世紀橫跨數十年的歷史

programme.title: 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: 曹家大老爺去世，留下家族企業及遺產給在法國念書的女兒飛飛管理，飛飛的大哥及堂哥心懷不軌欲將遺產占為己有大哥無意間救起落海的鳳，發現鳳與飛飛長相一模一樣，讓鳳假扮飛回家星在夜闖曹家行竊時被逮個正著，情急之下謊稱暗戀飛多年，將計就計與堂哥合作打算與飛結婚，順理成章分遺產

programme.title: 等一個人咖啡
programme.desc: 九把刀小說改編大學新鮮人思螢在神祕美麗老闆娘營業的等一個人咖啡店打工，她暗戀著看似身邊女友不斷的咖啡店常客澤于，卻總是遠遠等著他某天店裡來了風雲人物阿拓學長，兩人很快成為好朋友，思螢的生活因為阿拓出現而多彩多姿，當阿拓決定離開台灣實現夢想，思螢開始疑惑自己心中所等的人，真的是澤于嗎？

programme.title: 賭神之神
programme.desc: 亞洲賭王林在紹的一生極具傳奇色彩擁有變牌的超人技能百戰百勝，但他的變牌術原來竟是與魔鬼交易而獲得，最終使他身欠鉅債，不堪壓力選擇自殺此時一股莫名神力將他救回，他意識到賭場如深淵，魔鬼的面目也盡現在他的眼前，最後在眾人的幫助下迷途知返

programme.title: 鹿鼎記II神龍教
programme.desc: 龍兒（林青霞飾）重返神龍教繼承教主之職位，並奉命保護平西王吳三桂（秦沛飾）之子吳應熊（湯鎮業飾），前往京城晉見康熙（溫兆倫飾），並在麗春院巧遇韋小寶（周星馳飾）及阿珂（李嘉欣飾）康熙賜婚，命小寶護送建寧公主（邱淑貞飾）下嫁至雲南

programme.title: 庖丁傳奇之金刀御廚
programme.desc: 民以食為天，八大菜系中佛跳牆之由來有各種傳説，本故事即以兩位廚師及其後人經歷各種磨難，涅槃重生，創造此經典閩菜之過程

programme.title: 本日公休
programme.desc: 阿蕊開了四十年的男士家庭理髮，面對生活的煩擾，阿蕊總是以台灣歐巴桑的精神面對人生有天阿蕊接到一通電話，搬到遠方的老客人生病無法出門剪頭髮，拜託阿蕊到府服務阿蕊想起師傅教她這一行要服務客人到底，於是掛上本日公休的牌子，她要出發去做一件所有人都認為不值得的事

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山間，一僧一道比鄰而居和尚隨和開朗，有一女徒菁菁玲瓏可愛；道士古板嚴厲，徒弟嘉樂卻鬼馬頑皮性格不同的兩個師傅口角不斷，兩個冤家徒弟也笑料頻出某天，一支邊疆皇族屍隊路過此地，遭遇暴雨雷劈，殭屍破棺而出，大開殺戒烏侍郎攜王子僥倖逃命，但王子已中屍毒和尚與道士命徒兒照看王子，兩人則衝入樹林尋找千鶴道長

programme.title: 山忌：黃衣小飛俠
programme.desc: 一旦遇見祂，將迷失於山中嘉銘玉欣和安偉是大學登山社的好友某次登山途中，他們意外迷失方向，儘管沿路綁上白布條作記號，卻不斷繞回原處，彷彿陷入無盡迴圈荒亂之際，濃霧中隱約出現一個身穿黃色雨衣的身影，讓三人燃起希望；沒想到，詭異現象卻接連發生，真正的噩夢才剛剛開始

programme.title: 腥鞋遊戲
programme.desc: 富豪發起名為搶奪紅色高跟鞋的高額獎金遊戲，最終贏家將可獲得金錢與權力，但最高原則是：突破道德界線的玩法才有資格被認可！殘虐的遊戲就此失控展開，直到她的出現

programme.title: 逃出夏魘祭
programme.desc: 她與閨蜜們原本計畫度過一個開心的週末湖邊別墅之旅，未料慘遭邪教綁架，她要如何殺出重圍避免淪為獻祭的供品？

programme.title: 上流謀殺案
programme.desc: 1934年的英國南方，六位素昧平生的陌生人被邀請至億萬富翁路易斯芬利擁有的遺世獨居小島上作客但一場突如其來的兇殺案奪走其中一位房客的性命，聰慧且強悍的美麗客人米蘭達格林不得不展開調查，直至真相水落石出！

programme.title: 英勇交錯
programme.desc: 一個在困境中生活的年輕男孩一位英勇的士兵，以及一名來自遠方的不速之客，在黑海山丘上所交織而成的真實故事

programme.title: 倒數救援戰
programme.desc: 聖戰分子發動襲擊後，唯一倖存的黨羽哈姆札抓住桑提作為人質，桑提意外成了恐怖分子，他穿著炸彈背心穿梭在馬德里的格蘭大道，情報機構緊急應變小組，甚至媒體，全都動員起來設法拯救他的性命，這場驚心動魄的資源部署，卻迎來了意想不到的結果

programme.title: 獵殺侏儸紀
programme.desc: 2030年第三次世界大戰期間，一群倖存者逃入一座地下碉堡兩年後，他們必須離開碉堡找尋補給，但隨之而來的卻是恐龍的獵殺

programme.title: 絕命3小時
programme.desc: 曾是歷史地標的堡高醫院，荒廢已久並面臨即將拆除的命運，但某幫派卻在此藏了九千萬，隨著消息傳開，兩個敵對黑幫虎視眈眈，想要找出這筆贓款，未料卻被拆除工人麥可搶先發現，而距離建物爆破拆除期限僅剩短短三小時

programme.title: 童心馬戲團
programme.desc: 10歲的瑟希樂跟母親剛回到鄉下，她還不太適應那裡的生活這時正好來了一組巡迴馬戲團大家爭先恐後，都想一睹小馬波力的風采然而瑟希樂卻發現波力受到主人柏卡魯的虐待她想拯救波力她將波力藏了起來，不讓大人發現，並且意外地獲得神秘的維托及村裡其他小孩的幫助為了逃脫柏卡魯的追尋，瑟希樂跟波力展開了一段充滿驚喜的冒險

programme.title: 威利的異星大冒險
programme.desc: 隨著太空船因意外事故爆炸，在逃生過程中小威利被迫與家人分開，他的救生船降落到一顆原始無人的星球在那裏，他唯一的夥伴和依靠是一台古怪又能幹的維生機器人巴克由於與父母相聚的日子遙遙無期，救援船也遲遲未出現，威利必須設法在這個充滿怪奇生物的星球奮勇求生！

programme.title: 即刻反擊
programme.desc: 美樂莉是個身手矯健的美女特務，她受雇於神秘的地下組織，專門橫越全球執行政府不敢出面的危機任務然而當美樂莉在愛爾蘭執行任務時，身分遭到背叛曝光，成為所有國際間諜的刺殺目標性命危在旦夕的美樂莉，必須運用特務的技巧，逃過重重殺陣返回美國，瓦解遭到滲透的組織與背後的陰謀主使！

programme.title: 致命彈片
programme.desc: 前海軍陸戰隊員與他的老戰友槓上墨西哥販毒集團，試圖找出失蹤女兒的下落

programme.title: 殺手保鑣2
programme.desc: 億萬票房殺手保鑣系列續集，原班人馬霸氣回歸！首集的嗆辣老婆索妮亞保釋出獄後成為受保護的對象，為防止獨裁勢力摧毀整個歐洲，影史最強三賤客合體的嘴賤攻防，前所未見超乎想像！

programme.title: 雷霆殺陣首
programme.desc: 米榭爾維隆是個賽車天才，儘管家人持反對意見，米榭爾始終追求自己的理想，那就是一定要取得利曼24小時耐力賽冠軍憑藉著熱情與堅強體魄，以及冷靜的分析判斷能力，米榭爾終於拿到了這項比賽的冠軍一時媒體和車迷都奉他為世界賽車的未來天皇巨星就在各種鮮花喜悅包圍著米榭爾的同時，一場跨國的獵殺行動也悄悄展開

programme.title: 危機封城
programme.desc: 一群高中畢業生，厭倦了連續的封城，決定在海邊組織一場生命融合的狂歡派對但波羅的海出現了令人擔憂的高濃度藍藻菌和莫名感染病例，最初看似正常的沙灘舞蹈性愛飲酒愛與失望，隨著時間一分一秒過去，局面開始失控

programme.title: 舞力決戰
programme.desc: 街頭舞者安東夢想征服街舞世界，但一次嚴重的意外導致夢想粉碎，將他推進無聲世界失聰後的安東曾失去活下去的意義，直到他學會傾聽來自內心的樂音，開始教同樣失聰的小孩跳舞，成為他新的人生使命他開發出新的獨門舞步，冒險帶領這群小孩參加俄羅斯錦標賽，贏得世界冠軍賽的參賽資格

programme.title: 前線叛逃
programme.desc: 1942年夏天，史達林格勒附近爆發了激烈的戰鬥，將決定整個世界的命運20歲的謝爾蓋中士，一個還沒上過戰場的新兵，為了跟心愛的女孩道別，擅離前線部隊3小時，卻已構成逃兵罪而將面臨死刑所有人都知道這樣的懲罰太嚴苛，但戰爭機器的齒輪是否會為他停下？

programme.title: 追密者：失控正義
programme.desc: 女警凱薩琳是個單親媽媽，為了照顧女兒，自願擔任能有高薪的聯合國維安部隊某日，她遇見一名從妓院脫逃的女子，追問之下發現她和許多年輕女子在妓院遭受強暴凌虐等非人對待，且竟有法治人員牽涉其中凱薩琳下定決心查出真相，卻在調查中屢遭刁難，更發現聯合國似乎企圖粉飾太平，事件背後的腐敗黑幕也將遠比她預想的驚人

programme.title: 絕命目擊
programme.desc: 瑪麗安娜的生活平凡而規律，對周遭一切漠不關心在父母慘遭殺害之後，安妮的世界崩解，而瑪麗安娜是這樁命案的唯一目擊者，這個交會，讓她們一起成為追殺目標，活下來唯一的方法就是比兇手更早挖出真相！

programme.title: 特務殺很大
programme.desc: 一名罹患絕症的特務，接到組織交付的機密任務，該任務可以換取搶救他生命的藥物，但他一直隱瞞家人的特務身份也將被揭穿為了活命，特務不惜在巴黎殺出一條血路

programme.title: 奇楚亞救援
programme.desc: 在後世界末日的時代，一名懷孕的奇楚亞女孩和她的克里奧爾人伴侶，計畫從危險的難民營逃走，為新生命尋找更好的未來這場穿越數千公里的沙漠旅程因為被工業開發破壞而更為艱困，途中遇到一位試圖拯救難民的戰地記者，這場人道救援行動能否成功？

programme.title: 蝦米小白鯨
programme.desc: 這是年幼白鯨卡塔克的成長故事當卡塔克的同伴們都隨著年齡變為預期的白色時，卡塔克的發育卻顯得緩慢為了證明自己已經長大，並實現他所崇拜的奶奶的最後願望，卡塔克踏上了前往北方的危險旅程在途中，他遇到了致命的野獸，並結交了原本不可能有交集的朋友

programme.title: 五月的35日
programme.desc: 1940年，德軍佔領法國，從事記者工作的路德維希與他年僅12歲的兒子洛弗為了逃避納粹政府的通緝，已經在法國馬賽流亡三年，計畫帶著愛犬阿迪逃離歐洲前往紐約與妻子會合途中，兩人認識了與洛弗差不多大的牧羊女諾麗雅兒，三人一狗踏上了佈滿危險的未知旅程多項國際影展獲獎提名

programme.title: 神鬼戰隊
programme.desc: 特種部隊隊長塞達爾因遭遇伏擊而失去了16名士兵，被撤職以示負責，然而，政府正處於內外受敵的狀況，副國務卿提議組織一個特殊小隊來處理這些叛變狀況塞達爾被賦予隊長的任務，由傑出士兵和警察組成的特殊團隊（T..M），不管是內部叛徒或是外人，都必須全面肅清內外受敵，他們組成一支魔鬼部隊誓死抗敵！

programme.title: 星光首映場雷霆殺陣
programme.desc: 米榭爾維隆是個賽車天才，儘管家人持反對意見，米榭爾始終追求自己的理想，那就是一定要取得利曼24小時耐力賽冠軍憑藉著熱情與堅強體魄，以及冷靜的分析判斷能力，米榭爾終於拿到了這項比賽的冠軍一時媒體和車迷都奉他為世界賽車的未來天皇巨星就在各種鮮花喜悅包圍著米榭爾的同時，一場跨國的獵殺行動也悄悄展開

programme.title: 英雄訣53-54首
programme.desc: 英雄訣53-54首

programme.title: 惡水真相
programme.desc: 美國戰地攝影家尤金史密斯在二戰過後決定隱居，與社會和職業脫節，但生活雜誌編輯羅伯特海斯帶他來到日本熊本的水俁市，那是一個因日本窒素公司排放廢棄物而造成汞中毒的城市史密斯用相機紀錄人們受水俁病所苦的症狀，以及為公義所付出的努力他用一張張震懾人心的相片，為國際揭開這場令人心碎的歷史災難，也改變了當地居民的人生

programme.title: 蓬門碧玉紅顏淚
programme.desc: 1930年代美國密西西比小鎮，年輕英俊的歐文前來執行鐵路公司的裁員任務，與房東的女兒艾娃墜入情網但歐文令小鎮多人失業而備受當地人士排擠，艾娃的母親亦從中作梗，迫使這對愛侶分離

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王
programme.desc: 狄仁傑大破神都龍王案，獲御賜亢龍鐧，並掌管大理寺，使他成為武則天走向權力之路最大的威脅同時，洛陽城發生諸多離奇事件面對空前危機，狄仁傑要如何保住亢龍鐧？

programme.title: 孤雛淚
programme.desc: 英國維多利亞時期，身世不明的孤兒奧利佛困苦度日某日奧利佛只為多求得一碗粥而被認為不服管教轉賣給殯儀館當學徒，依舊擺脫不了受虐的命運，於是逃亡到倫敦，輾轉進入扒竊集團並被誤認為竊嫌，幸得目擊者於法庭上證明無辜富有的竊案失主布朗洛先生為補償奧利佛而將他帶回收留，殊不知他正是失蹤多年姪女的遺腹子

programme.title: 最好的我們
programme.desc: 一張舊照片，映入了攝影師耿耿的眼簾觸動了當年回憶的開關在那個恣意揮灑的青春年代裡，耿耿和資優生余淮成了鄰座校園內充斥著少男少女們懵懂青澀的賀爾蒙耿耿和余淮也不例外，兩人相約高考後再相見，但當耿耿滿懷期待前往約定之地，余淮卻像人間蒸發般渺無音訊當年余淮懸在嘴邊未說出的話那不辭而別的秘密，到底是什麼？

programme.title: 死神騎馬來
programme.desc: 十五年前的梅斯塔牧場，比爾一家人慘遭搶匪集團滅門，只有小比爾被一名晚到搶匪藏於馬車下而逃過一劫親眼目睹家人慘死的比爾，多年來苦練槍法一心復仇，在追查的過程中遇上甫出獄的中年牛仔瑞恩，兩人似乎有著共同的目標，帶著既像競爭又像合作的方式將匪徒逐一揪出擊斃，而比爾也漸漸發現瑞恩其實隱藏著一段秘密

programme.title: 九尾狐與飛天貓
programme.desc: 大小飛刀韓沖（梁家輝飾）韓林（林志穎飾）叔侄倆是令江湖人士聞風喪膽的城市獵人，在追捕鴛鴦大盜九尾狐（張學友飾）與飛天貓（張曼玉飾）的過程中，與大小風騷兩姊妹（張敏葉蘊儀飾）碰出了愛的火花就在他們擒拿住九尾狐與飛天貓時，意外發現東廠太監雷公公通敵賣國的證據，展開一場正邪之戰

programme.title: 時空冒險
programme.desc: 1985年，冒險家喬納森丹格迫降在距離非洲海岸20英里的一座島上他必須在蘇聯截捷足先登之前，找到一座能他讓回到過去的神廟，以求改寫有關太空競賽美蘇冷戰甚至第二次世界大戰等重大歷史事件！

programme.title: 英雄訣55-56首
programme.desc: 英雄訣55-56首

programme.title: 虎豹小霸王
programme.desc: 懷俄明州名號響亮的搶盜集團山洞幫以火車為搶劫目標，鐵路公司不堪損失，招募一批專業高手追捕隊設局擒拿，目標是靈魂人物布屈和日舞小子事發之後兩人無論使出什麼招數皆無法躲過追緝，最後決定與精通西班牙語的日舞女友艾塔三人，一起逃往南美洲的玻利維亞展開亡命生活，突然陰魂不散的追捕隊現身當地

programme.title: 半生緣
programme.desc: 改編自張愛玲的小説十八春，以1930年代的上海為背景，講述了黎明和吳倩蓮飾演的一對戀人在保守的時代因承受生命中不可得知的遭遇，飽受命運折磨的故事

programme.title: 野戰雄獅
programme.desc: 奠邊府戰役接近尾聲，拉斯沛奎上校帶領的法國傘兵部隊被越軍重重包圍，期盼許久的增援部隊在空降時卻被越軍無情射擊而所剩無幾，同為傘兵出身的伊斯科威上尉成為倖存的志願軍之一當法國承認越南獨立後，另一殖民地阿爾及利亞也吹起獨立號角；失意的拉斯沛奎上校臨危授命，找回伊斯科威上尉等戰友組訓一支傘兵部隊前往鎮壓，即將面對越戰時期昔日阿爾及利亞裔同袍的生死對決

programme.title: 從你的全世界路過
programme.desc: 陳末每天和王牌DJ小容針鋒相對，誰也不知道他們的仇恨從何而來陳末的兩個兄弟分別是全城最傻的豬頭，跟全城最純的茅十八，每天橫衝直撞的三人，都遇到人生的轉捩點失去所有的他們，弄丟了自己的出路，直到聽見來自世界的一段語音

programme.title: 偷龍轉鳳
programme.desc: 妮可是巴黎著名的邦尼家族千金，但邦尼家族私下係以偽造名家藝術贗品為樂巴黎一所博物館將舉行藝術品展覽，妮可的父親受邀參加，然而其中被視為偉大傑作的維納斯雕像，其實是她祖父製造的贗品，投保一百萬美元不料，保險公司要求技術鑑定，眼看事蹟即將敗露，妮可只得聘請一位高明神偷賽門偷走雕像

programme.title: 殲滅戰1941
programme.desc: 改編自二戰哈薩克名人阿迪沙里波夫的真實故事阿迪沙里波夫中尉與他的軍團在敵軍戰線的包圍下撤退未知的恐懼襲來，他們意識到毫不作為的等待將會比敵人的子彈更加致命

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 雲襄傳
programme.desc: 陳曉攜手毛曉彤闖江湖，智武雙全亂世見真情！！雲襄背負雲台門使命開始於江湖中走盪，因意外結識瀟灑帶勁的俠女舒亞男等其他能力之士而成為好友一同在波譎雲詭的江湖紛爭中成長理解仁德與尋找正義眾人尋覓禍亂天下的陰謀逐漸明朗時，雲襄決定挺身而出捍衛一切，守住天下大義

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 雲襄傳首完
programme.desc: 陳曉攜手毛曉彤闖江湖，智武雙全亂世見真情！！雲襄背負雲台門使命開始於江湖中走盪，因意外結識瀟灑帶勁的俠女舒亞男等其他能力之士而成為好友一同在波譎雲詭的江湖紛爭中成長理解仁德與尋找正義眾人尋覓禍亂天下的陰謀逐漸明朗時，雲襄決定挺身而出捍衛一切，守住天下大義

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記首
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.desc: 羅美蘭化身高年級實習生 道盡女性職場家庭壓力曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手如今成為上司的崔智媛在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: FOOD超人S1
programme.desc: 壞蛋蒼蠅王總是製造髒亂，還好有FOOD超人帶領5位超人，守護著FOOD島的環境！每集都在歡樂中，帶小朋友學習食物安全環境保護科學知識及生活常識！

programme.title: 往哪跑！
programme.desc: 俄羅斯經典動畫系列新作！歡樂悠閒的羅莎渡假村，歡迎世界各地的旅客，在此度過最放鬆的假期！然而，調皮的狼總是想和兔子一爭高下，藉此吸引鹿小姐的注意！

programme.title: 往哪跑！
programme.desc: 俄羅斯經典動畫系列新作！歡樂悠閒的羅莎渡假村，歡迎世界各地的旅客，在此度過最放鬆的假期！然而，調皮的狼總是想和兔子一爭高下，藉此吸引鹿小姐的注意！

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記
programme.desc: 動物園可真是個瘋狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陸的動物，如今都在一起共同生活但對一群好朋友來說，動物園就是他們的家！這裡有活潑好動的大象拉拉聰明的鱷魚沃比害羞的白虎咪噗俏皮的水獺可可子，還有勇敢的鴿子狄爾，快來和我們一起認識這群朋友吧！

Mastermind: 1977
programme.desc: Magnus Magnusson hosts the fifth heat of the quiz, with specialist subjects of the Spanish anarchist movement 1908-1975, the operas of Benjamin Britten, the history of the Royal Navy 1794-1805, and the Berry novels of Dornford Yates

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Robert Robinson presides over another duel of words and wits as Jenny Agutter, Sinead Cusack, Tim Rice and Nigel Dempster join team captains Frank Muir and Patrick Campbell. First broadcast in 1978

programme.title: The Search for the Lost Manuscript: Julian of Norwich
programme.desc: Historian Janina Ramirez tells the story of the first book written in English by a woman, Revelations of Divine Love by Julian of Norwich. The book was written in 1373 and presents an alternative viewpoint on mans relationship with God, which led to it being suppressed for more than 500 years. She travels from Norwich to Cambrai in Northern France, revealing how the book survived and the stories of women who championed it, and consults with academics and theologians about the books importance

programme.title: Romancing the Stone: The Golden Ages of British Sculpture
programme.desc: Alastair Sooke examines the three golden ages of British sculpture and the technical breakthroughs that made them possible. He begins with a look at the Norman ecclesiastical building programme and the masterworks created by anonymous medieval masons and artisans to the glory of God - until Henry VIIIs Reformation brought wholesale destruction

programme.title: Nature and Us: A History Through Art
programme.desc: James Fox uses art to explore how humans began to try to understand nature for the very first time. From the Song dynasty in China and the Islamic world, through to the Scientific Revolution and the advent of the industrial era, he shows the very different ways in which humans came to both appreciate and understand nature

programme.title: The Flying Gardener
programme.desc: Chris Beardshaw takes to the air in his helicopter and heads for Cornwall to create a tropical paradise in a schools backyard, regardless of weather and soil conditions. Along the way he takes a dip in the ocean in search of plants washed in from South America, and visits Britains very own Jurassic Park

programme.title: Archaeology: A Secret History
programme.desc: Richard Miles concludes his series charting the history of archaeological breakthroughs by discovering more about the ancient common man. The investigation takes the archaeologist from the elaborate grave of Egyptian boy king Tutankhamun to the Danish resting place of the Tollund Man, who died as part of an Iron Age sacrifice more than 2,000 years ago

programme.title: The Search for the Lost Manuscript: Julian of Norwich
programme.desc: Historian Janina Ramirez tells the story of the first book written in English by a woman, Revelations of Divine Love by Julian of Norwich. programme.title: Mas Fhior

programme.title: Trusadh Compelling Stories
programme.desc: The story of teenager Nuala MacDonald, from Acheninver in the north-west of Scotland, who has spent much of her life fighting for the support she needs as someone who is on the autistic spectrum. She now has plans to pave the way for change so that other youngsters dont face the same difficulties, working with schools and organisations to implement small changes in her community which will see Ullapool and the surrounding area become autism-friendly

In a tense final exchange, Sir Douglas and Kat finally come face to face, as she confronts the demons of her past in an attempt to bring Lady Marys killer to justice. Mark Bonnar narrates

With unprecedented access and interviews with industry insiders, Tir exposes a disturbing online underworld and its devastating consequences

programme.title: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Part one of two. The team is called to the scene of a drive-by shooting outside a London nightclub, joined by detectives from Operation Trident investigating a turf war between drug gangs. They uncover evidence that someone in the crowd may have returned fire, and the vehicle used is traced to an abandoned industrial unit, where a decomposing corpse is uncovered. Guest starring Craig Kelly

programme.title: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Part two of two. The detectives discover club owner Ainsley Modest is under pressure to hand over his establishment to a local gang - but isnt going down without a fight. With a second shoot-out imminent, the team face a race against time to track down the elusive gunsmith before he can arm both factions for the confrontation

With revealing interviews from detectives at the heart of the re-investigation and emotional first-time interviews from friends and family of the girls, the programme reveals how, after nearly 30 years, Waless first serial killer was finally unmasked

However, when a chance encounter at a suburban GP clinic throws their plans off course, the pair are forced to confront their lingering baggage. Return of the Australian comedy, starring Patrick Brammall and Harriet Dyer

Crime drama, starring Teyana Taylor

Charlotte also investigates the impact of drought on farming, and there is an encounter with a common crane

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels through Hungary, beginning his adventure in the far northwest of the country in the town of Sopron. In nearby Nagycenk, he discovers how the countrys national fire service was started by the son of Count Istvn Szchenyi. On arrival in the elegant capital city Budapest, Michael visits the exquisitely decorated Keleti station and finishes the evening with a drink at the New York Caf

programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they cant stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggees dream!

programme.title: The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, its gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.title: The Ambition Badge
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.

programme.title: The Aqueduct of Segovia
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch has turned the Segovia Aqueduct into a giant water slide, by removing some of its ancient stones to make it slope. But taking some of the perfectly balanced stones away means that the tall columns of the aqueduct are wobbling, and could come crashing down! The Go Jetters dont have long to stop Glitch and re-build the historic structure - Go Jetters, Go!

programme.title: The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are off to see the Geysers in Iceland, but Grandmaster Glitch and the Grimbots have beaten them to it, and managed to get themselves stuck in the Geysers.

programme.title: Mines of Mystery
programme.desc: Amidst Italys ancient sites and hidden treasures, Thomas is inspired to make his own special discovery and goes on a journey to find a lost legend.

programme.title: Museum
programme.desc: Stanley and the children tour the museum and quickly realise theres nothing about them or their friends, so they make a new exhibit all about their town today!

programme.title: Band
programme.desc: Fifi, Little Woo and Fred call up Stanley to ask him to film their new song. They go around the town trying to find the perfect place.

programme.title: I Could Be The Best Dancer In The Whole Entire World
programme.desc: From disco dancing frogs to skipping puffins and lions that love ballet, the talking animals discuss the best things about dancing.

programme.title: Its Time to Look for Signs
programme.desc: On the way home from Jareds shop with Gran Gran, JoJo finds out about the signs around them and what they mean. They are everywhere, and they all have a job to do. When they get home, Gran Gran has a plan to help JoJo make some signs of her own - there are even some special ones that they can share with Jared.

programme.title: Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Ghostbasket - Bluey special trilogy episode 1
programme.desc: Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies house to Mum, but Janet and Rita do not want to move out. They try to disrupt the sale by ambushing Mum in the hallway, driving their car through the kitchen and introducing Ghostbasket - a ghastly haunted washing basket.

programme.title: The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - its King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that finding their talents means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggees old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, theyre on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodris front door.

programme.title: Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds its time for some gardening!

programme.title: Seattle Space Needle, USA
programme.desc: Glitch has attached huge rocket boosters to Grim HQ in an attempt to become the first Grandmaster in space. As he thunders up into the night sky, it looks like he may actually do it this time. Then the boosters splutter to a stop and he crashes back to Earth. Glitch clambers to his feet amongst the wreckage of Grim HQ and demands the Grimbots find him another spaceship. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters arrive at the Seattle Space Needle, a huge spire with a futuristic viewing platform made to look like

programme.title: Lemon

programme.desc: Its Merry Sprouty Day, and everyone is waiting for Sprouty Claus, who is bringing presents to all the good fruit and veggies. However, Evil Pea has an evil plan - to steal the presents for herself!

programme.title: Merry Sprouty Day Part 2
programme.desc: Its Merry Sprouty Day, but Evil Pea jumps onto Sprouty Clauss train and steals all the presents for herself!

programme.title: Spinning

programme.title: Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dads birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: The Good Choices
programme.desc: The Squirrels havent been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggees help, they start to get it right. But not before sending Rolys imagination into overdrive!

As gliders do not have engines, Xuli is teaching two other pilot cadets how to glide using thermals to keep them up in the air. Not wanting to miss out on the aerial action, Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes the flying lesson in his Grim Glider! Not only has his glider got an engine, but he also wants to make the lesson into a race. Not cool...

programme.title: Steam Team to the Rescue
programme.desc: Thomas and the steam trains spring into action when Porter and the diesel engines run into a series of accidents that throw their deliveries off track.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tians rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tians granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted Venoms martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the familys young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huos stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the Little Lark in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy House of 72 tenants, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insiders look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiangs popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Mei, a young overseas Chinese woman, returns to Hong Kong to take over a traditional martial arts school. Her modern management style clashes with her conservative senior disciple, sparking disputes and attracting local gangsters. Forced to put aside their differences, they join forces to fight back and defend the schools honour.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiaos home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wifes faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a Generals daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend Investiture of the Gods, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperors Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Chengs friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee aka. Li Hsiu-hsien as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughters company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Mans father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laikas mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhangs custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lians affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Mins friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Mins death.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Reach For The Pod
programme.desc: When Sandra signs Pod 4 up for an academic quiz show, the kids are soon figuring out how to best leverage their TV exposure. It soon becomes obvious that four separate agenda do not add up to a cohesive team as they suffer near humiliation at the hands of the preppie team from Rydell High.

programme.title: Big Man On Canvas
programme.desc: Raffis win at the district art show hurtles Birch into the five stages of grief, her reactions throwing her podmates for a loop. Luckily, Liams hip to whats going on thanks to a book Mr. Towes has assigned him. While Sandra trails Liam in hopes of seeing some emotional fireworks on Birchs part, Raffi cant quite get over the idea that Birch wouldnt be happy for his success.

programme.title: The Pencil Assassin
programme.desc: Birch is initially aghast when Jason publishes her Manga sample in the school paper, but soon succumbs to the allure of popularity. As Birchs social status soars, her podmates become laughingstocks. Sandras retaliation eventually brings the two girls together in their fight against the unethical editor of The Cosmos Chronicle.

programme.title: Olivia Plays The Piano
programme.desc: Olivia sees herself as a great concert pianist, though her piano teacher thinks she needs a little more practice. But when her little brother Ian begins taking his own piano lessons and turns out to be pretty good Olivia isnt sure if theres room for two prodigies in the family.

programme.title: Olivia Plays Football
programme.desc: Francine is chosen to play goalie, and Olivia is disappointed that she doesnt get to wear the red goalie jersey. Even worse, the uniform she designs for herself only causes chaos and confusion among her teammates. But when Francine is better at dodging the ball than stopping it, its up to Olivia to put on the red goalie jersey and save the day

programme.title: The Cleat without Feet Real Magic
programme.desc: When Phoebe accidentally knocks Harpers soccer cleat off the balcony before the big game, the Dew Drops must venture into the city to retrieve the cleat. When Dylan starts practicing magic tricks, Athena thinks his magic is real! But when the Dew Drops investigate his magic hat, they accidentally break it and must fix it before Dylans magic show for the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: You Dont Snooze, You Lose Save The Squasher
programme.desc: When the crew takes on a mission to help Ian get some rest for a Badminton Tournament, Jax realises that the biggest approach isnt always the best approach. When Lula loses her comic book, Ari learns that the best heroes rely on teamwork and not gadgets.

programme.title: Gopher it! A Glamping We Will Go
programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Bully For You The Ra Animator
programme.desc: Bully For You When Casper decides he cant take any more of Thatchs nastiness, he forms a secret squad dedicated to putting an end to bullying. The Ra-minator Using the power of invisibility, Casper offers to help transform Ra from a sports zero to an athletic hero.

programme.title: Weekend At Bunnys Grimly Day
programme.desc: Weekend at Bunnys Alder and Dash sound the alarm after a terrifying creature threatens Scare School. Grimly Day Its Grimly Day?the grimmest day of the year!

programme.title: Gabby, I Shrunk the Kitties!
programme.desc: Gabby and Pandy accidentally get turned teeny-tiny when one of Mercats potions spills. To get back to their normal size, they need to find the right ingredients to make a grow potion, which means going on an itty-bitty search through the dollhouse! For our Cat of the Day segment, Mercat shows us how to make sparkly, mermaid slime.

programme.title: Its Purrsday!
programme.desc: Its Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: The Banana Bread Burglar Finding Meow Meow
programme.desc: When the banana bread Harper leaves out for Eden is stolen, the Dew Drops create a sting operation to catch the thief. When Captain Meow Meow gets a splinter in his paw and hears the word vet, he flees. Now its up to the Dew Drops to find Captain Meow Meow and get that splinter out.

programme.title: Catch that Drone The Fairy of the Teeth
programme.desc: When Harpers drone flies away its up to the Dew Drops to get it back. And while Eden wishes she could fly like a drone, she learns that she can do great things with or without wings. When Dylan loses his first tooth the Dew Drops learn that the Tooth Fairy will be coming and Athena tries so hard to make a good impression that she almost ruins Dylans first lost tooth experience.

programme.title: Little Sisters Tricky Treasure
programme.desc: Kelp and Pixie forget about their little sisters and their plans to hang out. Scallop goes to Unicorn Land and meets Juniper. They play and become friends. The unicorns are eager to play with a new mystery item that washes up on the beach, but what is it? While the other unicorns come up with imaginative ideas of what it could be, Pixie is determined to find out exactly what it is.

programme.title: Crabby Spe-shell
programme.desc: When Pixies pet crab goes into a cave, Kelp uses his knowledge of crabs under the sea to coax him out using dance and rhythm. Scallops special shell is broken, but Kelp transforms the broken bits into something even more special.

programme.title: Old Dog, New Tricks Snoozie-Hullabaloozie
programme.desc: Tag chooses to pair up with her Grandpaw for the Barker Family Talent Show, and together, they search for their winning talent. Tag is surprised to learn that today is the Pawston Snoozie-a-Hullabaloozie. With everything shut down for the day, Tag and Scooch take the opportunity to play all over town, while trying not to wake up other dogs.

programme.title: Show Dog, Show Keys to Victory
programme.desc: Tag cant wait to show off her car at the car show. But when Cheddar Biscuit wants to come along and pick up her clown friends along the way, Tag is wary that Cheddar Biscuit will steal her thunder. The Not Yet Cadets cant wait to watch Sams big race. But when Sam loses his car key, he challenges the Not Yet Cadets to race around town to find it.

programme.title: Belly Flop
programme.desc: The Riders have to save Elbone when hes swallowed by a giant Sea Gronckle, and Daks awful cooking might be just the thing to do it.

programme.title: Game of Horns
programme.desc: At a big town festival, Magnus challenges Duggard in a competition to be chief of Huttsgalor! Can the Riders help their friend keep his helmet?

programme.title: Everybody Loves a Sea Lion
programme.desc: When the happy-go-lucky sea lions draw crowds away from his show, Alex decides that he needs to act like the Sea Lions. When Alexs attempts to compete with them dont bring back the crowds, he learns to be true to himself rather than try to be someone hes not i.e. fish gotta swim, birds gotta fly, and lions gotta roar... and do backflips on land.

programme.title: Hippo Lake
programme.desc: When Gloria sneaks into the NY Ballet to audition for Swan Lake and gets rejected not for her dancing, but because shes a hippo, Glorias belief in herself is tested.

programme.title: Royal Review Funishment
programme.desc: Poppy faces her first royal review as Queen and sets out to ensure 100 happiness in Troll VillagePoppy must figure out how to handle crime in Troll Village when Cooper steals a pie.

programme.title: Bad News Bergens Unhealthy Competition
programme.desc: Poppy signs the Trolls up for a game of Bergenball with the toughest Bergen team aroundSmidge and Guy Diamond face off in a competition for juice dominance.

programme.title: Lucky and the Big Goodbye
programme.desc: While Lucky attempts to win over a town that is unwelcoming to the circus, she starts to question her own reasoning to stay

programme.title: Lucky and the Two-Wheeled Terror
programme.desc: When Lucky and the PALs arrive home from the circus, they find that Maricela and her new bicycle have become the star attraction in Miradero

programme.title: The Legend of Master Long-Tooth
programme.desc: Po and Blade must convince a deceased comic book writers son to give them information about an unreleased comic that may point them toward the next weapon: a whip of fire. However, after the events of 103 Po is now a wanted criminal, so the Emperors Forbidden Company arrives and captures him. Torn between saving Po and the mission shes sworn to complete, Blade flees and abandons Po.

programme.title: The Gateway to The Desert
programme.desc: A mysterious figure helps Po escape the guards, so Po makes his way to a desert market, determined to prove Blade wrong for leaving him behind. But when he accidentally stumbles into Klaus and Veruca, he and Blade awkwardly reunite while giving chase, and work through their differences. But the mysterious figure has followed Po and tries to capture them, clearly a new threat to our team.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: With a map from the comic book, Po and Blade make the treacherous journey through the desert to the lost city, and once inside they find the guardian of the fire whip, Rukhmini. The mysterious figure, a stag named Colin, forges an uneasy alliance with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Fugitives Day Out
programme.desc: Boss Baby is framed for leaking info about the Stinkless Serum to PuppyCo and must flee on the run via Errand Day with the family

programme.title: El Apasionado Negocio de la Niera
programme.desc: Frederic makes a play to take over the towns babysitters by instituting senior sitting

programme.title: Plushythingy
programme.desc: When Frederic Estes creates the cutest plushy ever that is the hottest toy in town, the field team must destroy the last remaining one but are powerless against its cuteness

programme.title: The Siege
programme.desc: Moray attacks the hauler with an EMP sending it into emergency lockdown and trapping the team inside. Now, its up to Roscoe, the only one small enough to fit through a vent, to find help. Meanwhile, Palindrome hunts down Moray using the evidence gathered by Ms. Nowhere.

programme.title: Into the Labyrinth
programme.desc: In order to stop Morays plan of directing a lava flow through Mexico City, the team must navigate through the underground tunnels and find his secret lair. But first they have to get their cars back from the DMV! Once they accomplish that, they learn that tunnels are much more complicated than they appear and Tony makes the ultimate sacrifice in order to help them stop Moray in time.

programme.title: Dont Go Chasing Lavafalls
programme.desc: Palindrome has been captured, Tony is gone, and Moray has activated his lava machine. The team starts to accept defeat, until Tony reveals that hes still alive! The team rallies behind this good news and launches one last attack to defeat Moray once and for all and stop the lava heading for the streets of Mexico City.

programme.title: The Intruder Flies a Crooked Path
programme.desc: When Jindiao arrives to the Village, he invites the kids to participate in an exhibition match, but has alternative motives

programme.title: A Fistful of Herbs
programme.desc: When Po discovers he was poisoned, he sets off to a caravan oasis in the hopes of finding out who the perpetrator is, unknowingly followed by the kid

programme.title: Poison in the Pit of the Plum
programme.desc: When Po and the kids stop for the night at an Inn, they meet a gang who wants to fight Po and end up down a path to uncovering Jindiaos evil plan

programme.title: What Goes Eep Must Come Dawn
programme.desc: After a crowverine gliding mishap, Dawn loses her confidence and tells Eep shes taking a break from adventures. Eep convinces Dawn to join her on one last adventure climbing Grrr Mountain.

programme.title: Parental Stridence
programme.desc: When Hope oversteps by trying to teach Sandy manners, Ugga gets her revenge by challenging Hope to do the impossible: civilize Thunk.

programme.title: The Flopping of the Bullruses
programme.desc: Ugga has a secret - shes taking Eep to flop with the bulrusses - a fun and dangerous pastime Ugga enjoyed as a teen. Uggas excitement fades when Hope invites herself and Dawn along.

programme.title: Barrel of Vine Tails
programme.desc: A mischievous new breed of dragons called Vine Tails steal the Book of Dragons.

programme.title: Scent of a Dragon
programme.desc: Tom and the riders must work together to rescue Eugene from a dragons nest.

programme.title: Sewer Koi and the Museum Heist
programme.desc: An earth-shaking rumble signals the arrival of a new creature, but Yi and Jin butt heads, each convinced theyre the better team leader. The crew eventually discovers that the massive Sewer Koi is behind the earthquakes, but hes missing his precious pearl, the key to a magical underground dam. Without it, the sewers water levels will rise, threatening to overflow and flood the whole city! Its going to take a heist to extract the pearl from its display at a local museum, before its too late.

programme.title: Peng vs. Peng
programme.desc: With the sudden closing of a local candy shop, NaiNai is busy trying to recreate its famous candied fruit. But after a late-night sugar binge in NaiNais stash, Peng starts acting strangely. It turns out that hes possessed by magical creatures! The Minticon are sugar-addicted puffball creatures, who previously lived in the old candy shop. Armed with her violin, Yi commands the creatures out of Pengs body, winning over the Minticon in the process.

programme.title: The Makeover
programme.desc: Liam starts acting even stranger when he falls in love with an older woman:15-year-old Cynthia. Birch, Sandra and Raffi conspire to give Liam a complete makeover to make him more appealing. Their plans backfire, making Liam look crazy instead of attractive.

programme.title: The Pom-Pom Girl
programme.desc: Sandra rises to the challenge of becoming a cheerleader, an act that stuns and mortifies her podmates. As Sandra succumbs to Amelias ridiculous hazing rituals Pod 4 becomes increasingly uneasy. But we soon learn that Sandra is only doing back flips to ensure her nemesis ultimate humiliation.

programme.title: Unreasonable Facsimilies
programme.desc: Overhearing Mr. Towes plan to throw a pop quiz Raffi uses the information to his advantage by studying. However, Raffis current obsession with texting has him including his own acronyms in his answers, thus creating irrefutable evidence for the teacher. Guilt finally undoes the pod with unlikely results.

programme.title: Planets Maligned
programme.desc: After a less than stellar day, Birch finds consolation in the pages of The Gemini Daily Planner she finds while cleaning her room. Impressed with its seeming accuracy, soon she wont make a move without consulting the book much to the escalating annoyance of the pod. A startling last-minute revelation keeps the pod from blowing apart.

programme.title: Olivia Trains Her Cat
programme.desc: When Olivias class holds a pet talent show, nobody can beat Francines amazingly talented cat Gwendolyn. Olivias lethargic cat Edwin, who barely moves, suddenly goes missing. Olivia then fancies herself a cat detective as shetracks down the missing cat.

programme.title: Olivias Lemonade Stand
programme.desc: Olivias lemonade stand is losing customers to Francines pink lemonade stand. Olivia does her one better by opening up her own full-scale backyard restaurant, imagining its a fabulous supper club. But Olivia soon finds that her restaurant needs something she can only get from Francine something pink!

programme.title: Olivia Takes A Road Trip
programme.desc: On the looooong drive to Grandmas house, Olivia finds ways to pass the time. She imagines her family traveling in style, as she pilots her very own jumbo jetOlivia Air! By the time they arrive at Grandmas, Olivias had so much fun that the discomfort of the road trip has been forgotten.

programme.title: Olivia Goes International
programme.desc: When asked to give a presentation for her classs International Day. Olivia cant decide which country to choose. Being Olivia she invents her own country Olivitania -where cupcakes are the national food and the national anthem sounds suspiciously like Puccini.

programme.title: The Sleepover Save The Very Hungry Vacuum
programme.desc: Marcus is having his first sleepover and Phoebe is concerned that Marcus may be nervous so Phoebe sets out to make sure he has the best first sleepover ever. When Athenas magical jump rope gets sucked up by the familys new robot vacuum, she loses confidence in her abilities, only to learn that her real abilities are already inside her.

programme.title: The Amazing Donna Bye, Bye Boardie
programme.desc: When Donna decides to show off her not-so-flashy skills as a magician at the Community Center talent show, the Zenkos must do everything they can to save her act from becoming an embarrassing disaster. After Sams favorite skateboard accidentally gets put in with donations Mr. Tanaka is collecting for a fundraiser, the team is led on a merry chase as the skateboard passes from one Harmony Harbor denizen to another.

programme.title: Lulas Last Stand Triple Trouble
programme.desc: Little Lula has set up a lemonade stand, but shes not getting any business. The Zenkos swing into action to send customers her way. When Donna, Fawna and Rona have a spat, the triplets longstanding annual tradition of viewing a comet together is in jeopardy. Now its up to Team Zenko to get the three feuding sisters back together again before the comet streaks by.

programme.title: Accidental Hero Rich Kid Ra
programme.desc: Accidental Hero In order to win the Fright Stuff Award, Casper consults his uncles for scaring advice. Rich Kid Ra When Ra pulls up to Scare School in a solid gold chariot, everyone suddenly wants to be his best friend.

programme.title: Dragon Quest Opposite Day
programme.desc: Dragon Quest The unlucky staff of a medieval-themed restaurant in Deedstown, get an unfriendly visit from Professor Thurdigree Burns. Opposite Day When Wolfies experiment with moonlight goes awry, everyone but Casper turns into his or her opposite.

programme.title: Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: Its time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lolas nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

programme.title: The Ticket Trail Flying Solo
programme.desc: Lola, Dylan and Cassie have tickets to the carnival, but when Dylan loses his ticket, the Dew Drops set out to find it. When Phoebe accidentally gets tossed into Nicholas diaper bag before a trip to the park, Phoebe has to help a baby bird, while Eden and Athena must help Marcus rehearse for his big concert.

programme.title: Spinny Water Kelps Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelps fun-crastinating puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Pupcakes Stink or Swim
programme.desc: When Tag discovers that Scooch is a great baker, she encourages him to start a pupcake stand. But when Tag rounds up more customers than Scooch is prepared to handle, Scooch cant keep up with the demand. Tag and Scoochs race to pick up the most trash on Pawston Beach is thwarted by Frank and Beans, who just want to make more of a mess.

programme.title: A Ball-For-All
programme.desc: Its Ball-entines Day, the day when the dogs of Pawston show their affection for each other by exchanging balls. But unfortunately, the town is fresh out, so Tag and Scooch set sail for Ball Island. If Tag and Scooch want to leave Ball Island with the balls they chose for their family, they must earn them by proving themselves ball-worthy, through a series of challenges from The Fetcher.

programme.title: The Nest
programme.desc: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, theyre invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove theyre kind and helpful.

programme.title: Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Daks lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leylas overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

programme.title: Best Fans Forever
programme.desc: The gang heads to Best Fans Day at NYs Giraffe Stadium, where Alex gets caught up in the attention of rooting for the winning team. When his behavior ends up hurting Martys feelings, Alex comes to learn that the only team that matters is the one thats made up of his friends.

programme.title: Gloriasaurus
programme.desc: The gang heads to the Museum of Dinosaurs. But Gloria becomes obsessed with her handheld video game and misses out on whats in front of her, and ends up creating a disaster of colossal proportions.

programme.title: Cloudy With A Chance Of Hugs Creek Week
programme.desc: The Trolls share a special hug with a special Troll on Hug DayWhen Creek returns to Troll Village everyone is willing to forgive him except Branch.

programme.title: The Giver Bellow Bug Day
programme.desc: Poppy attempts to discover which troll has been giving out yearly gifts at the Harvest MoonWhen Poppy accidentally ruins a Troll holiday her attempt to fix things keeps leading to more disasters.

programme.title: Lucky and the Rough Ride
programme.desc: The PALs join AI and Javier on a mustang drive, but when Javier gets injured, its up to Lucky and Spirit to get him to safety

programme.title: Lucky and the Ghostly Gotcha!
programme.desc: When Snips claims not to be afraid of ghosts, the PALs decide to give him a fun Halloween scare hell never forget!

programme.title: The Last Guardian
programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimis not exactly who she says she is. Our villains alliance shatters when Colin realizes the weasels are mages with magical powers, and he leaves Klaus gravely injured.

programme.title: A Thread In The Dark
programme.desc: Klaus is injured and Verucas mage powers are not working, stifled by her time in prison. They encounter a dangerous village and Veruca reconnects with her abilities in time to save Klaus, but the two are soon captured by Po and Blade, who are unaware of Verucas rekindled powers.

programme.title: Slow Boat to England
programme.desc: Po and Blade head to the docks to take Klaus and Veruca to England, and Po tries to have fun with her on their last day together. However, Klaus and Veruca break free and hold Po hostage Blade shockingly gives up the location of the fire whip to save him.

programme.title: Picture Perfect
programme.desc: Tim and Boss Baby want to bond with Dad by recreating a perfect Dudes Weekend camping trip, culminating in a photo opp, but everything seems to go wrong

programme.title: Play It Again, Tim
programme.desc: When Tim is forced to take piano lessons, he actually enjoys them and Boss Baby realizes that Tim is being brainwashed by his piano teacher, slowly turning Tim into an old man

programme.title: Research Developments
programme.desc: Turtleneck wants to crack the Stinkless Serum formula and makes it a competition, pitting worker babies against worker babies, stating that the first one to the Serum will be the new CEO!

programme.title: R.O.A.M. Around the World
programme.desc: With Ms. Nowhere and Palindrome off on a mission, the kids occupy their time playing the newest video game craze: Monster Manglers. But Tony isnt being a team player, which leads him solo into a mysterious race against an AI car. Is someone using this game as a trap for the Spy Racers?

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Tonys been kidnapped..by Sudarikov! The rest of the team must break into the plane where Tonys being held and rescue him all while 30,000 feet in the air!

programme.title: Big Trouble in Panda Village
programme.desc: The kids must leave Po to escape into the forest and head back to Panda Village to prepare against Jindiao

programme.title: Secrets Lost to Shadow
programme.desc: The kids meet an unlikely ally when trying to find Po

programme.title: Out of the Cave and Onto Thin Ice
programme.desc: After a shocking revelation, Po is determined to get his chi back and Jing decides to face Jindiao

programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Jhonny Gonzalez defending the WBO bantamweight title against Gerry Penalosa. A left hook to the body ends the fight. Also on the card, a controversial ending to the Nate Campbell Ali Funeka brawl.

programme.title: Fukuoka, Japan Episode 2
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 2 from Fukuoka, Japan.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles Sonny Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 3 of 4.

programme.title: Budapest 2023 - Episode 3
programme.desc: The highest level of competition in the sport of karate anywhere in the world will take place from Budapest, Hungary, as the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS take place. The top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, will all converge on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world. Dont miss the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, only on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA Amanda Lino vs. Rizlen Zouak
programme.desc: This episode features a womens banthamweight championship as Amanda Mad Dog Lino and Rizlen The Lioness of the Atlas Zouak fight their way to Fight of the Night honors. Bonus coverage showcases more striking power with Mzawandile Hlongwa vs. Robert Swanepoel and Steve Nwosu vs. Quinton Rossouw. From EFC 70 in Sibaya Casino, Durbin, South Africa on 26-May-2018.

programme.title: MEGA Fights Edwin Rodriguez vs. Jason Escalera
programme.desc: This episode features a USBA super middleweight title bout that sees Edwin Rodriguez defend against the undefeated Jason Escalera.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights Victor Ortiz vs. Vivian Harris
programme.desc: Wide World Of Fights includes all styles of fighting from around the world in one show! This episode features a middleweight brawl between top contenders Victor Ortiz and Vivian Harris, as well as kickboxing, sumo, arm wrestling and more!

programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles Sonny Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesnt give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cows nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA

Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clowns face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS

Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 夏日奇妙书My Marvellous Fable
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 勿擾飛升短劇Flying Up Without Disturb Mini drama

programme.title: 十天之後回到現實Tenday
programme.desc: 沉浸式生存闖關綜藝連續劇，邀請了吳奇隆陳妍希侯明昊林更新沈月等39位來自各行各業的高能闖關者，在真實城市中進行10天不間斷的全封閉生活，經歷腦力體力心理博弈團隊協作等遊戲關卡挑戰，最終所有關卡通關，勝出的人成最後的大贏家

programme.title: 我們的歌 第六季Singing With Legends Season 6 Repackaged
